scope.status: ENGINEERING PROTOTYPE - NOT RELEASED FOR ORDER
scope.silkscreen: White, both sides; J4 numbered signal labels and ESP32 wiring key
scope.mechanical_change: 146x62mm carrier; module 40x55mm with four M2.5 holes; no components under its 1.5mm stacking area.
scope.input_scope: One common floating DC supply; any positive/return/open assignment, with at least one positive and one return for live classification. Measure only; no power outputs or continuity test.
scope.power: External regulated 5V supply, nominal 5.1V; 5A source capability. CM5 socket currents require validation. F1 5A fuse and Q1 reverse-polarity protection.
scope.display: External compatible SPI display on optional J7; existing Waveshare ESP32 display is not a plug-in CM5 screen.
scope.isolation: Functional isolation from CM5/5V input via U6/U7; no mains or CAT rating.
scope.accuracy: Target +/-0.15V near 12V after room-temperature calibration; not physically verified.
scope.48V_note: Calculation stress only, not a survival rating.
scope.host: Compute Module 5, eMMC and Wi-Fi variant assumed; CM5102016 (2GB/16GB) candidate. Module purchased and installed separately.

interfaces.measurement: 100kHz isolated I2C, GPIO2/3; four ADS1115 at 0x48..0x4B
interfaces.expansion: Host SPI0 and I2C at J7; 3.3V logic only

scope.emitter: No DUT stimulus; output requirements unspecified.
scope.boot: Preimaged eMMC using an external CM5 IO board; Wi-Fi provisioning in image. CM5 Lite cannot boot on this carrier.
assumptions: eMMC/Wi-Fi CM5; user variant question unanswered at design time.
